content.label: OR
content.name: Such is the Joy of Our Reunion

enemies.name: Breakfast
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born from the daily meals of the people. Breakfast is the first meal of the day, and thus should be hearty and plentiful. Drops Sapidity when defeated.

abilities.text: Spawns 1 <Sapidity> when defeated

enemies.name: Dinner
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born from the daily meals of the people. Dinner is the last meal of the day, and thus should be refined but light. Drops Sapidity when defeated.

abilities.text: Spawns 1 <Sapidity> when defeated

enemies.name: 'Diet'
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a chopsticks holder left to collect dust. The chopsticks are laid aside when food no longer has taste. Too tired to live, and too tired to die. Such laments summon Vapidity.

abilities.text: Periodically summons 1 <Vapidity>

enemies.name: 'Fasting'
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a chopsticks holder left to collect dust for a century. The chopsticks are laid aside when food no longer has taste. Abhorring life and abhorring death, such loud laments summon Vapidity.

abilities.text: Periodically summons 1 <Vapidity>

enemies.name: 'Sated'
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a vessel for holding the five grains. The five grains are fundamental to sating hunger, and the vessel that stores them is appropriately solid and heavy.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked

enemies.name: 'Bloated'
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a hardened vessel for holding the five grains. The five grains are fundamental to sating hunger, and the vessel that stores them must not only be solid and heavy, but also exceptionally tough.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked

enemies.name: Expletive
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a broken clay pot. The dinner table has always been a place for petty squabbles, and the clay pot is hardly the only thing that gets broken.

abilities.text: Can use long-ranged weapons to attack <Sapidity>

enemies.name: Profanity
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a clay pot that broke someone's skull, itself undamaged. The dinner table has always been a place for squabbles. Tables are flipped and pots are broken, but in the end, everyone might still have to sit back down and eat together.

abilities.text: Can use long-ranged weapons to attack <Sapidity>

enemies.name: Boiling Pot
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Boil chili and pepper in the pot, and let the aroma drift across town. Do not be too hasty when you tuck in, lest the heat burn your mouth.

abilities.text: Continuously inflicts Arts damage and Burn to its surroundings
Immune to Slow

enemies.name: Drifting Aroma
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Boil chili and pepper in the pot, add some burdenbeast tallow, and let the aroma drift across town. Do not be too hasty when you tuck in, lest the heat burn your mouth.

abilities.text: Continuously inflicts Arts damage and Burn to its surroundings
Immune to Slow

enemies.name: Forethought
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Life is always easier when there is spare meat and grain in the kitchen. Those who have known hardship always keep something in stock for a rainy day.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.
Can collect up to 4 <Vapidity> or <Sapidity>; when full, moves towards <Derelict Stoves>
When defeated, spawns <Vapidity> equal to amount collected

enemies.name: Sureness
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Life is always easier when there is spare meat and grain in the kitchen. Those who have known hardship are not above stealing to keep a stock of food.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.
Can collect up to 4 <Vapidity> or <Sapidity>; when full, moves towards <Derelict Stoves>
When defeated, spawns <Vapidity> equal to amount collected

enemies.name: 'Vanity'
enemies.flavour_text: 'Put that one on my tab!' Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Often appears in drunken squabbles, but it is fragile and disappears easily.

abilities.text: Pulls 1 <Sapidity> within range towards itself, causing it to lose HP proportionate to distance moved when shifted

enemies.name: 'Humility'
enemies.flavour_text: A drink reveals one's true nature and inspires deep conversations. Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Often appears in drunken squabbles, but usually disappears once one is sober.

abilities.text: Pulls 1 <Sapidity> within range towards itself, causing it to lose HP proportionate to distance moved when shifted

enemies.name: Reminiscence
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a common water pot, it was not discarded even after its original purpose had become obsolete, being passed down through the family as a storage pot. Reach inside, and one can often find trinkets thought lost.

abilities.text: Can appear in the battlefield
Starts on standby
Can collect up to 1 <Vapidity> or <Sapidity>; On collection, activates and becomes aerial, moving towards <Derelict Stove>

enemies.name: Remembrance
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally an elaborate water pot, it was not discarded even after its original purpose had become obsolete, being passed down through the family as a storage pot. Reach into this unusually deep vessel, and one can often find trinkets thought lost.

abilities.text: Can appear in the battlefield
Starts on standby
Can collect up to 1 <Vapidity> or <Sapidity>; On collection, activates and becomes aerial, moving towards <Derelict Stove>

enemies.name: Wealth
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of the people's longing for a better life. Approach it carelessly, and copper coins will come at you in a way that you did not bargain for.

abilities.text: Spits copper coins to deal heavy damage at long range; Uses only melee attacks when out of coins
Can absorb nearby <Vapidity> or <Sapidity> to regain 1 copper coin

enemies.name: Prosperity
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of the people's longing for a better life. Approach it carelessly, and gold coins will come at you in a way that you did not bargain for.

abilities.text: Spits gold coins to deal heavy damage at long range; Uses only melee attacks when out of coins
Can absorb nearby <Vapidity> or <Sapidity> to regain 1 gold coin

enemies.name: Sapidity
enemies.flavour_text: Spirit born of the meals people cook every day. Everything picked up by the chopsticks—joy or sorrow, mirth or anger—is a slice of life.

abilities.text: Unblockable; Moves towards <Stoves> and can be absorbed by them, increasing their SP
Must be damaged 5 times to defeat; Spawns 1 <Vapidity> when defeated
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter; Automatically moves towards <Stoves>

enemies.name: Vapidity
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of the meals people discard. Put down the cup and lay aside the chopsticks. All is meaningless, and the meal on the plate vapid.

abilities.text: Unblockable; Moves towards <Derelict Stoves> and can be absorbed by them, increasing their SP
Must be damaged 15 times to defeat; Spawns 1 <Sapidity> when defeated
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter; Automatically moves towards <Derelict Stoves>

enemies.name: 'Sapid Auspice'
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of a convergence of Sapidity. Likes to hover over places where many gather, an auspicious symbol that drives out illness and keeps disaster away.

abilities.text: Deals True damage to all enemy units in its path
Cannot be attacked, does not count towards the defeated enemies counter, will not deplete Life Points on leaving the field

enemies.name: 'Vapid Blight'
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born of a convergence of Vapidity. Likes to hover over places that are barren and broken, a symbol of misfortune.

abilities.text: Deals True damage to all allied units in its path
Cannot be attacked, does not count towards the defeated enemies counter, will not deplete Life Points on leaving the field

enemies.name: Mouth of Annihilation
enemies.flavour_text: Devours Sapidity and Vapidity.

abilities.text: Absorbs all nearby <Vapidity> and <Sapidity>
Disappears when <Mouth of Creation> disappears

enemies.name: Mouth of Creation
enemies.flavour_text: Spits out Sapidity and Vapidity.

abilities.text: Teleports <Vapidity> and <Sapidity> absorbed by <Mouth of Annihilation> towards itself
Disappears when <Mouth of Annihilation> disappears

enemies.name: Gluttony
enemies.flavour_text: Abomination born from the heart of the Sui proxy, awakened from dream, devouring disappointment. There is taste in reunion, as there is in remembrance. There is taste in joy, as there is in sorrow. There is taste in pride, as there is in regret.

abilities.text: [Metal Constitution] Takes reduced Physical and Arts damage. Effect temporarily disabled after taking damage from <Sapid Auspice>. When in Glutton form, the effect is increased, and the effect downtime is shortened
[Open Invitation] Absorbs all nearby <Sapidity> and <Vapidity> to increase its own SP
[Boundless Greed] When SP is at max, summons <Vapid Blight>, dealing True damage to all allied units
Wrath of Hunger
[Raid and Plunder] Spits acid at 1 allied unit within range; all allied units in the acidic area take continuous Arts damage
[Insatiable Desire] Summons additional <Vapidity>; effect increases in Glutton form
[Greed] When HP drops to 0, summons a large number of <Vapidity>, and transforms into Glutton form after some time
Glutton
Gains increased ATK, ASPD, and DEF; attacks become ranged

[Hoarding Avarice] Transforms all <Sapidity> to <Vapidity>, and periodically pulls all <Vapidity> towards itself; while skill is active, becomes immune to control effects, and absorbing <Vapidity> restores HP
[Devour Terrain] Summons <Mouth of Annihilation> and <Mouth of Creation>
